review_method.viewport_method: Formal-domain visual inspection in an isolated agent-browser session at 375x900, 768x1024, and 1440x900
review_method.browser_visual_check: Passed on https://chickenfarmgame.wiki/ after DNS and TLS activation; no horizontal overflow was observed and the primary CTA was clicked through to the internal beginner guide.

evidence: Formal homepage rendered at 375x900 with scrollWidth equal to viewport width (375px).
Hero copy, illustration transition, and both calls to action were legible without clipping.
Navigation collapsed behind a labeled 44px menu control.
The largest visible clickable was Start the beginner guide, targeting /beginner-guide/.
Formal homepage rendered at 768x1024 with scrollWidth equal to viewport width (768px).
Tablet navigation, hero copy, calls to action, and farm illustration were fully visible without overlap.
The largest visible clickable was Start the beginner guide, targeting /beginner-guide/.
Formal homepage rendered at 1440x900 with scrollWidth equal to viewport width (1440px).
The two-column hero, bounded content, navigation, calls to action, and farm illustration were fully visible without overlap.
The largest visible clickable was Start the beginner guide; clicking it reached https://chickenfarmgame.wiki/beginner-guide/.

navigation_checks.notes: All internal links and fragments are checked by src/lint.mjs; the beginner guide links back to the homepage sections.

fact_reference_checks.notes: Published copy excludes current code lists, exact rebirth costs, complete chicken tiers, and exact Gem Upgrade effects.

issues_and_resolutions.issue: The candidate called the first purchase an egg even though approved research says players buy chickens and convert eggs into cash.
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: Codex corrected homepage and tutorial copy to buy a chicken, collect and deposit eggs, then collect cash.

issues_and_resolutions.issue: The candidate lacked production SEO files and a social preview image.
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: Codex added canonical metadata, Open Graph/Twitter metadata, JSON-LD, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, security headers, and an original social card.

issues_and_resolutions.issue: The initial acceptance record was limited to static viewport checks because the browser lock was unavailable.
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: The authorized retry completed formal-domain visual checks at 375, 768, and 1440 pixels in an isolated browser session; the primary CTA was confirmed as an internal beginner-guide entry.
